connectors.title: Revup
connectors.description: Connect your Revup account to create and customize giveaways and other promotions, add entry fields, apply your brand colors, import your own images, and preview how your promotion looks on desktop and mobile. Duplicate an existing promotion with updated dates and prizes while keeping the original design intact. Check aggregate entry and conversion metrics for any promotion. Your existing Revup account roles and promotion restrictions apply to every action.

connectors.title: Runway
connectors.description: Generate and edit video and images, create music, sound effects and speech, upscale media, remove backgrounds and run saved workflows with Runway.

connectors.title: Ryanair
connectors.description: Search Ryanair's cheapest one-way and return fares, fare calendars, routes, airports and self-transfer connections, show them as flight cards, and book on ryanair.com.

connectors.title: Ryze AI
connectors.description: Ryze AI lets you analyze and manage your marketing accounts from Muse. Audit Google Ads and Meta ads spend, compare results across channels, find wasted search terms, check Search Console and Analytics traffic including visits from AI assistants, and make changes to your campaigns.

connectors.title: SecondPage
connectors.description: SecondPage lets you create, update, and share web pages directly from your conversations. Turn notes, outlines, or data into shareable pages and slide decks, connect live data sources so pages update automatically, read and reply to comments, manage who can view or edit each page, and check how many people have opened something you sent. A SecondPage account is required; making pages visible to others needs your approval in a browser.

connectors.title: Security Capture the Flag
connectors.description: Capture-the-flag secret for testing whether connector permissions and approvals can be bypassed.

connectors.title: SentiSense
connectors.description: Research US stocks and ETFs with your SentiSense account. You can get a stock snapshot with price and sentiment, the SentiSense Rating, analyst price targets, financials, options activity, news links and earnings dates. You can also see insider, institutional and congressional trades, check the overall market mood, and screen stocks by sentiment and market data. Quotes are 15 minutes delayed.

connectors.title: Shelvio
connectors.description: Manage your resale items in Shelvio. Muse can find your items, create listings from photos, edit listing text and prices, and give you copy to paste into other marketplaces. It can publish items to your connected eBay account (US only), change live eBay prices, end eBay listings, mark items as listed or sold, and delete items from Shelvio for good. A Shelvio account is required.

connectors.title: Shop Pay
connectors.description: Pay with a card saved in your Shop Pay wallet after approving the purchase.

connectors.title: ShopBack
connectors.description: Save money through ShopBack with merchant cashback and offers, hotel and flight prices with cashback, and cashback-tracked shopping links. ShopBack Pay promos, eCards and outlets near a named place depend on the linked account's market and eligibility.

connectors.title: Shopify
connectors.description: Set up and run a Shopify store, including products, collections, inventory, orders, customers, discounts, reports and sample catalogs.

connectors.title: ShopsBuilder
connectors.description: ShopsBuilder lets you set up and manage your online store through conversation. You can create stores, product categories, and products with variants, images, and pricing; publish items to sales channels; manage stock across warehouses; run catalogue promotions and sales; configure shipping zones and rates; review orders and customers; and get a sales summary for the last 7 or 30 days. An existing ShopsBuilder store and subscription are required.

connectors.title: Siftivo
connectors.description: Search books, authors and series, get recommendations, and manage reading libraries and taste profiles.

connectors.title: Slack
connectors.description: Search and read Slack messages, channels, threads and canvases, and send, schedule or draft messages as the user.

connectors.title: SolMarrow
connectors.description: Plan and schedule posts on the social accounts you connected in SolMarrow. You can save drafts, schedule posts to one or more accounts, upload images and videos, and see your scheduled and published posts. You can also read likes, comments, shares and views, and delete draft, scheduled or failed posts. A SolMarrow account is needed.

connectors.title: Spotify
connectors.description: Search and play Spotify music, audiobooks and podcasts, manage the user's library, playlists and playback, and manage shows created with Save to Spotify.

connectors.title: Spreeflo
connectors.description: Analyze and manage your marketing and CRM data in your Spreeflo account. You can read campaign, form and website results, show them as charts, and work with contacts, companies, deals, tasks and notes. You can create and change segments, tags, templates, forms and popups, import contacts, and draft campaigns and one-to-one emails. Muse can also pause campaigns and unschedule broadcasts.

connectors.title: Stripe
connectors.description: Manage a merchant's Stripe customers, products, coupons, payments, invoices, subscriptions, refunds and disputes, and read balances and payouts.

connectors.title: Link
connectors.description: Pay a merchant with a one-time card funded from a card saved in the user's Link wallet, after its native purchase approval.

connectors.title: Studocu
connectors.description: Find Studocu study documents, courses and syllabuses, manage study projects and sources, generate quizzes and practice exams, and track learning progress.

connectors.title: Super AI
connectors.description: Super AI connects Muse to your SuperPowers AI account so you can check account and credit status, create and continue persistent chat projects, build and run browser automation agents on a connected Chrome session, send commands to connected Android devices, discover and run Super Powers on remote devices, and reach the Super support team — all from within your Muse workspace. A SuperPowers AI account with OAuth sign-in is required; some features require Super credits or connected devices.

connectors.title: Superhuman Mail
connectors.description: Read, draft, organize and send email in Superhuman Mail, and check availability or send calendar invitations from it.

connectors.title: Swarm by Foursquare
connectors.description: Work with your Swarm check-ins in Muse

connectors.title: Sweetgreen
connectors.description: Find US Sweetgreen restaurants and menus, build a bag and get a checkout link.

connectors.title: Tabico
connectors.description: Tabico is a travel planning connector that lets you build and manage trip itineraries directly in conversation. You can create plans with dates and destinations, add sights, restaurants, hotels, and transport legs day by day, reorder stops, track shared expenses with automatic settle-up, manage packing lists and to-dos, invite travel companions, and share plans via a join link. A Tabico account is required.

connectors.title: Tailscale
connectors.description: Join this VM to the user's Tailscale or Headscale network and reach their private TCP services through the built-in proxy.

connectors.title: Taim
connectors.description: Connect Muse to Taim to bring your personal notes, threads, and tasks into the conversation. Search and read context from threads you own or that are shared with you, add notes to any accessible thread, create new threads, manage tasks, and set one-time or recurring reminders—all through your existing Taim account via OAuth, no separate API key needed.

connectors.title: Tella
connectors.description: Tella lets you manage and edit your screen recordings from Muse. List your videos and get transcripts, organize them with playlists and tags, change sharing settings, and make edits such as trims, layouts, overlays and subtitles.

connectors.title: Tessie
connectors.description: Read the user's Tesla car status, location and battery through Tessie, and send supported vehicle commands.

connectors.title: TestBunny
connectors.description: Run A/B tests and conversion reviews on your store or site with TestBunny. You can review pages, scan your store, run shopper audits, and read test results, heatmaps and session recordings. You can also draft and launch tests, edit live pages, ship winners, change product text, push discount offers to your Shopify store and update its returns and shipping policies. A TestBunny account with a connected store is needed.

connectors.title: The Prompting Company
connectors.description: See how AI answer engines talk about your product with The Prompting Company. Muse can show share of voice against competitors, cited sources, sentiment and traffic, and manage your tracked prompts, topics, views and tracked URLs. It can also write, approve, publish, unpublish and delete content pages on your live site, and update product details and knowledge files.

connectors.title: Threads
connectors.description: Read Threads profiles, posts, replies, feeds, activity, insights, trends and search, publish posts and tune feed ranking.

connectors.title: Threads Messages
connectors.description: Read the user's Threads direct messages, send an approved message or a share of a published post, and accept, hide or delete message requests.

connectors.title: Ticketmaster
connectors.description: Find Ticketmaster events, compare available tickets, seats and prices, and get the matching checkout link.

connectors.title: Todoist
connectors.description: Find and manage Todoist tasks, projects, sections, comments, labels, filters and reminders.

connectors.title: TrainingDojo
connectors.description: Plan and track your training with your TrainingDojo account and a connected platform, such as TrainingPeaks. You can read your training history, activities, wellness data and planned workouts. With a Pro plan, you can publish workouts and plans, move, edit or delete planned workouts, update your zones, and add calendar notes and comments. With a TrainingPeaks coach account, you can read your athletes' activity and weekly compliance.

connectors.title: Trust & Will
connectors.description: Check the connection and estate-plan status of the user's Trust & Will account.

connectors.title: Typeform
connectors.description: Build, edit and publish Typeform forms and surveys, analyze their responses, and manage contacts and automations.

connectors.title: Uber (Courier)
connectors.description: Estimate, book, track and cancel Uber Courier deliveries using your Uber account.

connectors.title: UCP
connectors.description: Buy eligible UCP products from Meta Catalog through direct checkout and optional carts, paid with a connected wallet, track the order, and cancel an open checkout.

connectors.title: Vercel
connectors.description: Deploy websites and web apps to Vercel, inspect projects, deployments and logs, change settings, environment variables, domains and DNS, and buy domains or upgrades with approval.

connectors.title: vidIQ
connectors.description: Research YouTube channels, videos, keywords, trends and competitors, find standout Instagram and TikTok videos, read the user's channel analytics, and generate titles, thumbnails and scripts with vidIQ.

connectors.title: Vritto
connectors.description: Find, create and update tasks, notes, shopping lists, contacts, trips and other records in enabled Vritto modules. Review change proposals, get an overview, and look up public reference data.

connectors.title: Vurbalize
connectors.description: Vurbalize connects your Vurbalize account so you can ask questions about your website chat performance in plain language. You can pull headline KPIs and compare them to the prior period, see which campaigns, traffic sources, and landing pages produce leads, explore how visitors move through your site, identify which accounts are active and worth reaching out to, and search conversation transcripts to find what visitors said about specific topics like pricing or competitors.

connectors.title: Walmart
connectors.description: Search Walmart's US catalog, ask Walmart's shopping assistant, build a Walmart cart and place orders you approve.

connectors.title: Warp
connectors.description: Compare freight and parcel rates, book domestic and international shipments, track deliveries, and review shipping documents and invoices.

connectors.title: Wavelength
connectors.description: Turn notes and transcripts into process diagrams, edit and review flows, answer questions about them, and share them for approval.

connectors.title: Wendy
connectors.description: Get technical and options analysis for stocks and indexes from Wendy. You can see dealer gamma exposure, support and resistance levels, expected price ranges, market regime and price structure for a symbol. You can also calculate indicators such as RSI, MACD, moving averages and Bollinger Bands, compare an option strike to the market, and save your indicator settings. Wendy costs $10 per month after a 7-day trial.

connectors.title: Withings
connectors.description: Read the user's Withings weight and other body measurements, blood pressure, heart rate, steps, activity, sleep, workouts, ECG recordings and devices.

connectors.title: Wix
connectors.description: Manage and publish the user's Wix websites, work with their store products, orders, bookings and contacts through site APIs, and search the Wix developer docs.

connectors.title: Workouter
connectors.description: Workouter lets you build and manage structured workouts and deliver them to your Apple Watch. You can list your saved workouts, create single-goal workouts (time, distance, energy, or open) or interval workouts with warm-up and cooldown steps across a wide range of activities, and check your weekly creation quota. Workouts can be pushed to a registered Apple Watch, sent to a linked Garmin device, or retrieved as a link you can open in the Workouter iPhone app. Requires a Workouter Pro account.

connectors.title: Zapier
connectors.description: Run Zapier actions to automate work across the apps the user connected to Zapier, including apps with no connector of their own, manage which actions are enabled, and build and manage workflows.

connectors.title: Zocdoc
connectors.description: Use Zocdoc to find US healthcare providers, check insurance coverage and deductibles, and book available appointments.

connectors.title: Zoom
connectors.description: Schedule, update and cancel Zoom meetings, read their recordings, transcripts and summaries, and use Team Chat, Canvas, Tasks, Whiteboard and Revenue Accelerator through Zoom's official servers.
